$comment: Input to @oresoftware/ores-contracts, the fleet's existing parity toolkit. It reads the PERSISTED subset only -- contracts/typespec/main.tsp and contracts/json-schema/contract.schema.json -- parses each authority into its own IR, drives the same emitters from each, and byte-compares the results. This repo does not reimplement any of that. scripts/parity.mjs adds only what ores-contracts deliberately does not cover: the wire-only types (session frames, HTTP errors, the discovery surface), the fixture corpus, and the protobuf alignment.
